All the applicants are advised to bring their original certificates and other relevant documents including
publications (with photocopy of certificates) for verification along with the duly filled form giving the
details at the time of interview.
The application form for the post of Assistant Professor is available at website
https://jobs.puchd.ac.in/show-forms.php pages 1 to 9.
The candidate shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any fellowship/stipend or any
financial assistance from any agency till they are teaching in the University Institute of Laws, P. U.
Regional Centre, Ludhiana as a Guest Faculty.
